name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Soft one-bowl chocolate chip cookies made with coconut oil and soy milk.

steps.text: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 180°C (top and bottom heating, not fan forced).
In a large bowl, cream together the coconut oil and brown sugar with a fork. The coconut oil needs to be solid for this recipe, not melted — if soft, place it in the fridge until hardened.
Add the milk, maple syrup, vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Mix well — the mixture might look a bit clumpy.
Sift the flour into the bowl and stir until partially combined.
Fold the chocolate chips through the dough. Be careful not to over-mix.
Scoop up 1 tbsp of dough at a time and roll into balls. Place on the baking tray about 5cm apart as the cookies will spread.
To decorate, add a few bits of chopped chocolate to the top of each cookie if desired.
Bake on the centre rack for 12–13 minutes, or until lightly golden. Let them set on the baking tray for a minute before transferring to a cooling rack to cool completely.
